howTo.title: How to Use the Username Generator
lead: Every batch is built from three things: the word you type, the style you pick, and the options under Customize. Leave the word blank and the generator pairs two words from the style instead, so it works as a random name maker as well as a username maker for your own name.
There is no sign-up and nothing is sent to a server. The vocabulary lives in the page, so the page works offline once it has loaded.
steps: Your first name, a nickname, a pet, a hobby — anything short. The generator keeps it intact and builds around it; leave it empty for fully random username ideas.
Aesthetic, cute, cool, gaming, funny, dark, fantasy, minimal, emo, preppy, retro or nature. Or keep All Styles selected to compare them side by side.
Use the quick filters to narrow the batch, heart the ones you like, then copy one or all of them. Click Generate More whenever your favorite turns out to be taken.

platforms.title: Username Generator for Instagram, TikTok, Discord & Games
platforms.intro: The same generator works everywhere. These shortcuts pick settings that suit each platform's username rules, and the linked pages go deeper on each one.

cards.title: Instagram Usernames
cards.text: Instagram allows letters, numbers, periods and underscores, up to 30 characters. Short, lowercase, one aesthetic word — and a period when the plain version is taken.

cards.title: TikTok Usernames
cards.text: TikTok handles get said out loud and typed from memory, so favor names that are easy to spell and easy to hear — cute or funny pairings do this well.

cards.title: Discord Usernames
cards.text: Discord usernames are lowercase letters, numbers, periods and underscores. Keep the handle plain and save symbols and fancy lettering for the display name.

cards.title: Gaming Usernames
cards.text: Game profiles rarely allow symbols or periods, so plain letters and numbers travel best. Each game has its own page with format rules built in.

formulas.title: How to Make a Good Username
formulas.intro: The generator follows a handful of simple formulas. Knowing them helps you tweak a result — or build your own username from scratch.
rows: **Alex** + **Haze** → the most natural pairing; the noun sets the mood
**Frost** + **Alex** → describes you before your name lands
**Velvet** + **Moon** → no name at all, just imagery
**Alex** + **Haze** with a period or underscore → frees up a taken name
**its** / **just** / **lil** + **Alex** → reads like a caption, easy to remember
**Alex** → **alexx**, **alecks** → keeps the sound, changes the string
**Alex** + **444** / **777** → numbers with meaning look intentional, random ones look like a fallback
**Alex** + ⋆ → one decorative mark, where the platform allows it
formulas.note: A good rule: use one trick per username. *alexhaze* is clean; *xo_alexx.haze444⋆* is not. If the plain version is taken, add a period first, a number second, and a symbol only where the platform supports it.

guide.title: How This Username Generator Works
guide.intro: There is no AI behind this page and no database of taken names. Usernames are assembled in your browser from five ingredients:
bullets: The name or word you type is cleaned to letters and numbers and kept whole in every result. Leave it blank and the generator picks a noun from the style instead.

Each of the 12 styles has its own hand-written list of adjectives, nouns and suffixes — bunny, peach and honey for cute; vortex, frost and shadow for cool; knight, sniper and titan for gaming — so a cute result never borrows a gaming word by accident.

Word + noun, adjective + word, prefix + word, two style words, subtle respellings such as a doubled letter, and short numeric suffixes. Patterns rotate within a batch so you never get 24 versions of the same idea.
Periods, underscores, lucky numbers like 444 or 777, and birth-year-style digits. On the default Mix setting only some results get them; pick a specific option to apply it to every result.

Each style has a matching set — hearts for cute, stars for cool, moons for dark — placed before, after, around or between the words. Most username fields reject them, so use Symbols: None for a handle and keep the decorated version for a display name.
outro: Results and favorites never leave your device. Favorites are stored with your browser's localStorage, which is why they survive a reload but not a different browser. Because nothing here talks to Instagram, TikTok, Discord or Roblox, the generator cannot tell you whether a username is free — always check on the platform itself.

uniqueBody: A list of 500 username ideas is only useful until the 499 other people who read it take the good ones. A username generator built around *your* word is different: **alexhaze** or **frostalex** is far less likely to be taken than **moonchild**, because it starts from something specific to you. That is why every pattern on this page keeps your word whole rather than replacing it.

If you want a name that has nothing to do with you — for an anonymous account, an alt or a brand — leave the box empty. The generator then combines two vocabulary words from the chosen style, which behaves like a random username maker with a consistent mood. The dedicated pages for [aesthetic](/aesthetic-username-generator.html), [cute](/cute-username-generator.html), [cool](/cool-username-generator.html), [gaming](/gaming-username-generator.html), [fantasy](/fantasy-username-generator.html), [emo](/emo-username-generator.html), [rare](/rare-username-generator.html) and [short](/short-username-generator.html) usernames each carry a much larger word list than the shared styles here, so if you already know the vibe you want, start there.

Whatever you pick, check the platform's rules before you commit: Instagram and Discord allow periods and underscores but no symbols in the handle, Roblox allows one underscore, Reddit allows underscores and hyphens, and most games cap the length at 12 to 20 characters.

faqs: A username generator is a tool that combines a word you choose with curated vocabulary — adjectives, nouns and suffixes tied to a style such as cute, cool or gaming — and naming patterns to produce username ideas. This one runs entirely in your browser, is free, and lets you copy any result.
How do I make a unique username?

Start with something specific to you — a name, a nickname, a hobby — and pair it with one style word: alex + haze becomes alexhaze. Names built from your own word are far less likely to be taken than names copied from a list. If the plain version is gone, add a period or a lucky number before you add anything else.
Can I generate a username with no name?

Yes. Leave the word box empty and the generator pairs two words from the chosen style instead — velvetmoon, wobblytoast, pixelknight. That makes it a random username maker for anonymous accounts, alts and brand names.
Does the username generator check availability?

No. Nothing on this page talks to Instagram, TikTok, Discord, Roblox or any other service, so it cannot know whether a name is taken. Copy the one you like and check it on the platform itself — availability changes by the minute.

Aesthetic, cute, cool, gaming, funny, dark, fantasy, minimal, emo, preppy, retro and nature. Each style has its own vocabulary and symbol set, and most of them also have a dedicated page with a larger word list, for example the [cute usernames page](/cute-username-generator.html) and the [gaming usernames page](/gaming-username-generator.html).
What characters can I use in a username?

It depends on the platform. Instagram, TikTok and Discord accept letters, numbers, periods and underscores; Roblox allows letters, numbers and a single underscore; Reddit allows underscores and hyphens. Symbols like ♡ or ⋆ almost never work in a handle, so set Symbols to None for the username and use the decorated version as a display name.
Can I use these usernames for gaming?

Yes. Pick the Gaming style, set Symbols to None and Separator to None, and the results are plain gamertags that Xbox, PlayStation, Steam and most games accept. For game-specific rules use the [Roblox usernames page](/roblox-username-generator.html) or the [gaming usernames page](/gaming-username-generator.html).
How do I make my username look fancy?

Generate the plain username here, then paste it into the [cursive text generator](/cursive-text-generator.html) or the [fancy text generator](/fancy-text-generator.html) to convert it into cursive, bold, bubble or aesthetic Unicode letters for your display name or bio.
